title: Rounding drain in vault share accounting
hypothesis: The first depositor mints one share and donates 10,000 USDC of collateral before anyone else deposits. A victim who then deposits up to 10,000 USDC is minted zero shares, and the attacker redeems the donation plus the victim's deposit, so each victim loses up to 10,000 USDC.
claimed_impact: Permanent loss of user funds via inflated share ratio: each victim loses up to 10,000 USDC
mechanism: First depositor inflates the share price before the pool opens
preconditions: Vault freshly deployed with empty reserves
scope_statement: Vault deposit and mint path is in scope for this review
reproduction_summary: Step 1: mint one share. Step 2: donate collateral. Step 3: redeem.
